definitions.explanation: A domesticated carnivorous mammal, commonly kept as a pet or working animal.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{犬|いぬ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: That dog is big, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}いたい→飼う：08151_kau⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want to have a dog.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{犬|いぬ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I walk the dog every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦うち→内：01328_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{犬|いぬ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っています→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧。
examples.english: Our dog is ten years old, but still healthy and runs around every day.

notes:
{犬|いぬ} is the general word for dog.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {犬|いぬ}を{飼|か}う: to keep/own a dog
- {犬|いぬ}の{散歩|さんぽ}: dog walking
- {犬|いぬ}が{吠|ほ}える: the dog barks

JAPANESE BREEDS:
- {柴犬|しばいぬ}: Shiba Inu
- {秋田犬|あきたいぬ}: Akita
- {土佐犬|とさいぬ}: Tosa

RELATED WORDS:
- {子犬|こいぬ}: puppy
- {番犬|ばんけん}: guard dog
- {野良犬|のらいぬ}: stray dog
- {愛犬|あいけん}: beloved pet dog

CULTURAL NOTE:
The story of {ハチ公|ハチこう}, the loyal Akita who waited for his deceased owner at Shibuya Station for years, is famous in Japan. His statue remains a popular meeting spot.
